placements.why: The content describes a mandatory onboarding process that replaced a prior system — this is organizational practice, requiring a strata category nothing existing covers.
placements.title: Organizational processes as institutional norms
placements.frame: How are operational processes established, mandated, and superseded as settled organizational practice?

placements.title: From wiki page to mandated checklist
placements.frame: How does a named onboarding artifact become a non-negotiable institutional norm that all new hires must complete?
placements.why: Both expressions perform the same theme: the Pallasine checklist is presented as a ratified, universal mandate (every new hire completes it) with institutional history (it replaced the old wiki page). This is a thematic container for how onboarding processes become settled norms, not a single fact.
